text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Transitional National Council passes election law to allow soldiers and security forces members to vote in barracks on November 28 in referendum to amend the constitution.
- Festivities to mark the 42nd anniversary of Algeria's independence war begin throughout the country.
- A working group between government officials, businesses and workers union representatives discuss income tax.
- Algerian dinar to become a full convertible currency in 1998.
- The Transitional National Council debates a new trade law to step up economic reforms towards free market.
